# OpenThesis 1.2.3

## 中文

此版本重点提高中国 A 股财报研究的可靠性，并完善报告阅读与本地历史管理。

- 巨潮资讯的完整年度报告与季度、半年度公告分开查询，A 股公司优先使用本市场完整年报。
- “综合收益”不再被识别为营业收入；负收入、极端年度变化和资产负债异常会在 AI 调用前被拦截。
- 重新解析同一披露文件时事务性替换旧事实，避免错误缓存继续影响新研究。
- 非技术模式递归隐藏 Evidence ID、Agent ID、机会 ID 和响应元数据，并本地化常见结构化字段。
- 技术详情按钮加入明确的选中状态。
- 研究历史支持安全删除；用户手动保存的投资逻辑不会随自动研究记录删除。
- Windows 便携版解压即可运行，不显示命令行窗口。

下载 `OpenThesis-1.2.3-windows-x64-portable.zip`，完整解压后运行
`OpenThesis\OpenThesis.exe`。首次启动默认不调用 AI。

## English

This release focuses on more reliable China A-share filing research and improves
report reading and local history management.

- CNInfo full annual reports are queried separately from quarterly and interim
  announcements, with native A-share annual reports preferred.
- Comprehensive income can no longer become revenue. Negative revenue, extreme
  year-over-year changes, and balance-sheet anomalies stop the run before any AI call.
- Re-parsing an official filing transactionally replaces stale extracted facts.
- Non-technical reports recursively hide evidence, agent, opportunity, and response
  protocol identifiers while localizing common structured fields.
- The technical-details control now has an unmistakable active state.
- Research history can be deleted safely while preserving theses saved manually by users.
- The Windows portable build runs after extraction without opening a console window.

Download `OpenThesis-1.2.3-windows-x64-portable.zip`, extract it completely, and run
`OpenThesis\OpenThesis.exe`. AI remains disabled by default on first launch.
